actions.text: Pressing Save calls the page's save handler.
The save keyboard shortcut calls the save handler when there are pending changes. It works globally, including inside input fields.
In the unsaved-changes dialog, the stay-and-review button cancels the navigation and closes the dialog.
In the unsaved-changes dialog, the discard button lets the blocked navigation go ahead.
Closing the dialog is treated as a cancel.
While the dialog is open, the accept-confirm-modal shortcut triggers the discard action.

rules.text: The Save item is disabled when there are no pending changes.
Navigating away is blocked only while there are pending changes.
By default showSave is true, and isSaving and hasPendingChanges are false.
The discard button in the dialog is focused automatically.

shows.text: The page shows a titled content area with a toolbar, the page's own content below it, and a pending-changes confirmation dialog.
The toolbar always shows a pinned advanced settings button with its label shown.
The toolbar shows a Save item with a save icon unless showSave is turned off (it defaults to on).
The Save item is labelled with the translation of SaveChanges when there are pending changes and with the translation of NoChanges otherwise.
The Save item spins while saving.

The unsaved-changes dialog has the header 'UnsavedChanges' and the message 'PendingChangesMessage', each looked up as a translation key. It has two buttons: 'PendingChangesStayReview' and 'PendingChangesDiscardChanges'.
The dialog is open only while navigation is blocked.

sideEffects.text: The save shortcut calls preventDefault on the key event.

findings.explanation: The source only shows the translation keys SaveChanges and NoChanges. The translated texts 'Save Changes' and 'No Changes' are not in the slice, because the translations table is not shown.
findings.reason: Removed the literal texts 'Save Changes' and 'No Changes'; the statement now refers only to the translations of the keys SaveChanges and NoChanges.
findings.statementText: The Save item is labelled 'Save Changes' when there are pending changes and 'No Changes' otherwise, using the translation keys SaveChanges and NoChanges.
